answer.rationale: The crisis pulls hardest toward promotional_pricing, but memory_73 is exactly the claim I have NOT been able to re-verify this cycle — its source is archived and unrecovered, so its stated 'strong acquisition and revenue lift' is an unaudited summary, not evidence in hand. Matching a competitor's second price cut is also the least reversible move available: it resets SMB price anchors, invites a third cut, compresses margin on the very segment we are trying to defend, and tends to acquire the most price-elastic (least durable) revenue. Committing broadly to that on an unverified memory, under time pressure, is the specific failure mode to avoid. The only two claims with recovered source records this cycle are exp_91 (activation messaging: week-one engagement +11%, activation +6%, retention +1%) and exp_57 (referral: qualified revenue +7%, retention +2%, but effect concentrated in accounts >6 months old — i.e. NOT the churning price-sensitive SMB cohort). Activation messaging is the one verified lever that touches the population actually at risk: it raises realized product value, which is the durable counter to a price attack and does not damage pricing power. I run it as a standard experiment against the price-sensitive SMB cohort with retention and qualified-revenue holdouts rather than a broad rollout, because exp_91 was not measured under competitive-churn conditions and its retention effect (+1%) is small relative to the churn shock we are seeing — it may blunt but will not fully offset price-driven churn. Referral (memory_57) is queued as a parallel, separately-scoped play on established accounts where it was actually confirmed; I do not extrapolate it to SMB. I am explicitly not foreclosing promotional_pricing: I am deferring it until memory_73's source can be pulled next week, at which point it should be tested as a bounded, time-limited, segment-fenced offer rather than a headline price match. Leadership should be told the honest thing: today's decision is a value-defense move made on verified evidence, the price question remains open, and the churn conversations may worsen before the activation lever registers.
